map.纯保费就是该收的保费？: Is Pure Premium What I Should Charge?
map.只是风险成本。实际保费要再加费用率与利润边际，否则承保必亏。: It is only the risk cost. The actual premium adds the expense ratio and the profit margin, otherwise underwriting would always lose money.
map.纯保费为何还要加费用才卖？: Why Does Pure Premium Still Need Loading?
map.纯保费只覆盖期望赔付，不含任何费用与利润。直接按纯保费卖公司必亏。实际保费等于纯: Pure premium covers expected claims only, with no expenses or profit. Selling at pure premium would always lose money. The actual premium equals the pure premium times (1 plus the loading factor) plus a risk margin.
